summary: import_role statically loads a role at a chosen point among tasks; keywords apply to the role's tasks, not the statement. Role vars and defaults are exposed at parse time, and it does not work in handlers.
questions: How do I run a role in the middle of my tasks?
What's the difference between import_role and include_role?
Why are a role's variables visible before import_role runs?
Can I use import_role in handlers?

answer_card.title: import_role (static role loading)
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.import_role` loads a role statically at a point in your task list. `when`, loops, etc. apply to **each imported task**, not the statement (use `include_role` for the opposite).
- Role `vars`/`defaults` are exposed at **parse time**, so earlier tasks see them.
- Handlers are available to the whole play.
- Not usable in handlers.
